note_zh: 每一行是被测项目在基准所用版本上的功能事实，不是评分。依据：bench/systems.json、各适配器的 README、bench/results/summary.md 里的说明、research/reports/ 下的调研报告，以及项目自己的公开仓库页面；查不到的写“未确认”。
note_en: Each row holds functional facts about a benchmarked project at the version the benchmark used; it is not a score. Sources: bench/systems.json, each adapter's README, the notes in bench/results/summary.md, the reports under research/reports/, and the project's own public repository page; anything not found there is 'not confirmed'.

columns.zh: 默认写入是否调用大模型
columns.en: Default write calls a language model

form.zh: 网关：HTTP 服务，也可以在聊天程序的进程内调用
form.en: Gateway: an HTTP service, or called in-process from the chat program

retrieval.zh: 按后端选：关键词（sqlite，字符二元组加 IDF）、向量（embedding）、混合（hybrid，概率“或”融合），或通过 openviking 后端用 OpenViking 的向量检索
retrieval.en: Chosen by backend: keyword (sqlite, character bigrams + IDF), vector (embedding), hybrid (probabilistic-OR fusion), or OpenViking's vector search through the openviking backend

write_llm.zh: 否。用 openviking 后端时，抽取由 OpenViking 用它自己配置的模型做
write_llm.en: No. With the openviking backend, extraction is done by OpenViking with the model configured there

delivery.zh: 最多 5 条（上限 10）；有分数线（min_score、relative_score；默认是宽松档 broad，向量和混合配置每题约 1.5 – 2.5 条，`profile = "precise"` 精确档约 0.7 – 1.2 条）；有字数预算（默认 1500 字，整条取舍）；由聊天程序在回复前调用召回（AstrBot 示例每轮回复前自动召回）
delivery.en: Up to 5 items (ceiling 10); score thresholds (min_score, relative_score; the default is the broad profile, which delivers about 1.5 – 2.5 items per question with the vector and hybrid configurations, and `profile = "precise"` about 0.7 – 1.2); a character budget (1500 by default, whole items only); the chat program calls recall before replying (the AstrBot example does so before every reply)

forgetting.zh: 可选的遗忘曲线，默认关闭：长期没被用到的记忆先降权，再存档后删除；存档在保留期内可恢复
forgetting.en: Optional forgetting curve, off by default: memories that go unused are down-weighted, then archived and deleted; the archive can be restored within its retention

form.zh: 库（带命令行）加 DSH 插件
form.en: Library (with a CLI) plus a DSH plugin

retrieval.zh: 混合：稠密向量加 BM25，RRF 融合（默认 Milvus Lite）；记忆存成 Markdown 文件
retrieval.en: Hybrid: dense vectors plus BM25 fused by RRF (Milvus Lite by default); memories are Markdown files

write_llm.zh: 库：否，建索引只算嵌入。DSH 插件采集对话时默认用模型总结每一轮（据项目 README 的配置说明）
write_llm.en: Library: no, indexing only computes embeddings. The DSH plugin summarises each captured turn with a model by default (per the project's README configuration section)

delivery.zh: 前 5 条；无分数线；无字数预算；插件不自动注入，由模型决定是否调用 memory-recall 技能
delivery.en: Top 5; no threshold; no character budget; the plugin does not inject automatically, the model decides whether to call the memory-recall skill

forgetting.zh: 无衰减或过期；删除跟随 Markdown 文件
forgetting.en: No decay or expiry; deletion follows the Markdown files

form.zh: 库（进程内调用 Memory 接口）

retrieval.zh: 混合：语义向量加 BM25 加实体加权；默认写入时先由大模型抽取事实，存的是事实
retrieval.en: Hybrid: semantic vectors plus BM25 plus an entity boost; by default a language model extracts facts at write time and the facts are stored

write_llm.zh: 是：add 的正常路径（infer=True）每次调用一次大模型；infer=False 只算嵌入
write_llm.en: Yes: the normal add path (infer=True) makes one language-model call per add; infer=False only computes embeddings

delivery.zh: top_k 20；分数线 0.1；无字数预算；不注入，提示词由应用自己拼
delivery.en: top_k 20; threshold 0.1; no character budget; no injection, the application builds the prompt

forgetting.zh: 无自动衰减；可选按条到期日（expiration_date）
forgetting.en: No automatic decay; an optional per-memory expiry date (expiration_date)

version.zh: v0.5.3（容器镜像按 digest 固定）

form.zh: 服务（HTTP），另有 DSH 插件

retrieval.zh: 向量检索记忆文件（本基准用 bge-m3）；会话提交时由大模型抽取记忆
retrieval.en: Vector search over memory files (bge-m3 in this benchmark); memories are extracted by a language model on session commit

write_llm.zh: 是：正常写入（会话提交）由配置的模型抽取；直接写记忆文件（本基准的做法）不调模型
write_llm.en: Yes: the normal write (session commit) extracts with the configured model; writing memory files directly (as this benchmark does) does not

delivery.zh: API 默认 10 条；无分数线；字数预算：未确认；DSH 插件的默认值和是否自动注入：未确认
delivery.en: API default 10 items; no threshold; character budget: not confirmed; the DSH plugin's defaults and whether it injects automatically: not confirmed

retrieval.zh: 图：大模型从文本抽取实体和带时间的事实边，在事实边上做 BM25 加向量的混合检索（RRF）
retrieval.en: Graph: a language model extracts entities and time-stamped fact edges; search is hybrid BM25 plus vectors over the fact edges (RRF)

write_llm.zh: 是：没有大模型写不进去（本基准实测每条记忆约 2.5 次调用）
write_llm.en: Yes: nothing can be written without a language model (measured here: about 2.5 calls per memory)

delivery.zh: 默认 10 条；有余弦下限 0.6；无 token 预算；返回事实边，提示词由调用方拼
delivery.en: 10 items by default; a cosine floor of 0.6; no token budget; returns fact edges, the caller builds the prompt

forgetting.zh: 无时间衰减；被新事实否定的旧事实标记失效，不删除
forgetting.en: No time decay; facts contradicted by newer ones are marked invalid, not deleted

form.zh: 宿主无关的内核库加宿主适配器（AstrBot；DSH 适配器 0.0.1）
form.en: Host-independent kernel library plus host adapters (AstrBot; DSH adapter 0.0.1)

retrieval.zh: 关键词：BM25 加图激活，无向量检索
retrieval.en: Keyword: BM25 plus graph activation, no vector search

write_llm.zh: 是：正常写入路径是宿主模型抽取（有每日次数上限），另有夜间整理
write_llm.en: Yes: the normal write path is extraction by the host model (with a daily limit), plus a nightly consolidation

delivery.zh: 最多 8 条；有证据阈值（相对最高分）；有字数预算（600 字）；宿主每轮自动注入
delivery.en: Up to 8 items; an evidence gate (relative to the best candidate); a character budget (600); injected automatically by the host every turn

forgetting.zh: 遗忘曲线 R(t)=exp(-t/S)；定期清扫把保持率低于 0.3 的非 fact 记忆标为遗忘（行保留，可逆）；fact 级不遗忘
forgetting.en: Forgetting curve R(t)=exp(-t/S); a periodic sweep marks non-fact memories whose retention falls below 0.3 as forgotten (row kept, reversible); level fact is never forgotten

retrieval.zh: 关键词加实体加图信号（SQLite）；向量是可选项，默认关闭
retrieval.en: Keyword, entity and graph signals (SQLite); vectors are optional and off by default

write_llm.zh: 是：默认写入路径是大模型驱动的空闲复盘
write_llm.en: Yes: the default write path is a language-model-driven idle review

delivery.zh: 运行时记忆（USER.md、MEMORY.md）的快照在记忆变化时自动追加进对话；记忆空间由模型调用召回工具，每次最多 4 条、3600 字，有分数线（默认策略丢掉 0.25 以下）
delivery.en: A snapshot of runtime memory (USER.md, MEMORY.md) is appended to the conversation automatically when memory changes; Memory Spaces are recalled when the model calls the recall tool, at most 4 results and 3600 characters per call, with a score floor (the default policy drops below 0.25)

forgetting.zh: 按 id 软删除；容量满时自动裁掉最弱的记忆；时间衰减：未确认
forgetting.en: Soft delete by id; the weakest memories are pruned automatically when capacity is reached; time decay: not confirmed

form.zh: DSH 插件（Node，带一个 Python 子进程）
form.en: DSH plugin (Node, with a Python child process)

retrieval.zh: 关键词：BM25，无向量；记忆是普通文件
retrieval.en: Keyword: BM25, no vectors; memories are plain files

write_llm.zh: 否：写入闸门、去重和索引都是规则代码
write_llm.en: No: the write gate, dedupe and index are rule-based code

delivery.zh: 每轮自动注入会话里最新的 4 条（共 1400 字）和最近 10 条消息（900 字），不看问题、无分数线；按问题检索要模型调用 cg 工具
delivery.en: Every turn it injects the 4 newest items of the session (1400 characters) and the last 10 messages (900 characters), regardless of the question and without a threshold; question-based search is a cg tool the model calls

forgetting.zh: 只降权和折叠，不自动删除；可以手动软删到回收区
forgetting.en: Down-weighting and folding only, no automatic deletion; manual soft delete to a trash area

retrieval.zh: 关键词：BM25（中文按字二元组），按重要度和时间加权
retrieval.en: Keyword: BM25 (Chinese as character bigrams), weighted by importance and recency

write_llm.zh: 宿主代理的模型通过工具写入并填关键词，不另起模型调用；后台反思和梦境整合另用宿主模型
write_llm.en: The host agent's model writes through a tool and supplies the keywords, with no separate model call; background reflection and dream consolidation use the host model as well

delivery.zh: 每条用户消息前自动注入关键词命中的前 2 条；无分数线；字数预算：未确认
delivery.en: Before every user message, the top 2 keyword hits are injected automatically; no threshold; character budget: not confirmed

forgetting.zh: 排序时按时间降权，不删除；删除是把状态改成归档（行保留）
forgetting.en: Recency lowers the ranking without deleting; deleting sets the status to archived (row kept)
